```{r cache=FALSE}
#| echo=FALSE

selectInput(
  "quality_score",
  "Quality Score",
  choices = 1:11,
  selected = 6
)

sliderInput(
  "sale_year",
  "Sale Year",
  min = 1997,
  max = 2026,
  value = round(mean(c(1997, 2026))),
  step  = 1
)

sliderInput(
  "year_built",
  "Year Built",
  min   = 1870,
  max   = 2026,
  value = round(mean(c(1870, 2026))),
  step  = 1
)

selectInput(
  "bathrooms",
  "Bathrooms",
  choices = c(
    0.00, 1.00, 2.00, 3.00, 4.00, 5.00, 6.00, 7.00, 8.00, 9.00
  ),
  selected = 2.00
)

sliderInput(
  "square_feet",
  "Living Area (sqft)",
  min   = 120,
  max   = 17787,
  # snap the initial value onto the step grid (min + n*step) so the handle works
  value = 120 + round((mean(c(120, 17787)) - 120) / 10) * 10,
  step  = 10
)

sliderInput(
  "land_net_square_feet",
  "Land Area (sqft)",
  min   = 546,
  max   = 2940736,
  value = 546 + round((mean(c(546, 2940736)) - 546) / 50) * 50,
  step  = 50
)

# Hidden numeric inputs for map coordinates
tags$div(style="display:none;",
  numericInput("latitude",  "Latitude",  value = NA),
  numericInput("longitude", "Longitude", value = NA)
)

```

<!-- ## Server (observeEvent) -->

```{r cache=FALSE}
#| context: server

library(caret)
library(lightgbm)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

# Load your model bundle
bundle <- readRDS("../models/final_lightgbm_app_model.rds")

# Load map data
council  <- st_read("../analysis/Pierce_County_Council_Districts_8934877056349991897.geojson") |> st_transform(4326)
zipcodes <- st_read("../analysis/Zip Codes.geojson") |> st_transform(4326)

# Render map
output$map <- renderLeaflet({
  leaflet() %>%
    addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = zipcodes,
      group = "ZIP Codes",
      color = "gray",
      weight = 1,
      fillOpacity = 0.15
    ) %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = council,
      group = "Districts",
      layerId = ~District_Number,
      color = "red",
      weight = 2,
      fillOpacity = 0.30,
      popup = ~paste0("<b>District</b><br>District: ", District_Number)
    ) %>%
    addLayersControl(
      overlayGroups = c("ZIP Codes", "Districts"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    )
})

# Map click: district polygons
observeEvent(input$map_shape_click, {
  click <- input$map_shape_click

  updateNumericInput(session, "latitude",  value = click$lat)
  updateNumericInput(session, "longitude", value = click$lng)

  output$click_info <- renderText({
    paste0(
      "District selected\n",
      "District: ", click$id, "\n",
      "Latitude: ", round(click$lat, 6), "\n",
      "Longitude: ", round(click$lng, 6)
    )
  })
})

# Map click: outside polygons
observeEvent(input$map_click, {
  click <- input$map_click

  updateNumericInput(session, "latitude",  value = click$lat)
  updateNumericInput(session, "longitude", value = click$lng)

  output$click_info <- renderText({
    paste0(
      "Coordinates selected\n",
      "Latitude: ", round(click$lat, 6), "\n",
      "Longitude: ", round(click$lng, 6)
    )
  })
})

# ---- Helper: build a prediction row from UI inputs ----
make_row <- function(input) {

  all_vars <- bundle$dummy_model$vars
  row <- as.data.frame(as.list(rep(0, length(all_vars))))
  names(row) <- all_vars

  # selectInput() returns character strings; coerce everything to numeric so
  # predict.dummyVars() doesn't treat them as single-level factors.
  row$sale_year              <- as.numeric(input$sale_year)
  row$quality_score          <- as.numeric(input$quality_score)
  row$year_built             <- as.numeric(input$year_built)
  row$bathrooms              <- as.numeric(input$bathrooms)
  row$square_feet            <- as.numeric(input$square_feet)
  row$land_net_square_feet   <- as.numeric(input$land_net_square_feet)
  row$latitude               <- as.numeric(input$latitude)
  row$longitude              <- as.numeric(input$longitude)

  row
}

# ---- Reactive prediction (auto-updates) ----
prediction <- reactive({

  row <- make_row(input)

  X <- predict(bundle$dummy_model, newdata = row)
  X <- X[, bundle$features, drop = FALSE]

  pred_log <- predict(bundle$model, data.matrix(X))
  pred <- exp(pred_log)

  round(pred)
})

# Button-triggered prediction
observeEvent(input$predict, {
  # Show a "Calculating ..." panel while the model runs, then display the result.
  withProgress(message = "Calculating ...", value = 1, {
    pred <- prediction()
  })
  output$prediction <- renderText({
    paste("Predicted price =", pred)
  })
})
```
